svg.aria-label: Highlights: TMS in the testing workflow — Brought the Sfera TMS into the process, so test cases and other test artifacts take less time to write.; Redis as a testing tool — By changing values in the cache the service reads first, we could reproduce rare errors and push through requests the system would normally reject.; Shared test data — One common place and format for test data that anyone on the team can use.; Traffic generation with scapy — First at Eltex to generate network traffic with Python and scapy scripts.
